ValidationRule.description: Ensures that an agent has selected a Yes value to 'Have All Defects Been Rectified' if any other field has been selected as a No
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false), (RecordType.DeveloperName = "KYC_QA"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c, "Not Applicable" ), OR( ISPICKVAL (Fraud_ID_True_Document__c, "No"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_ID_Not_Picture__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Customer_Photo_Modified__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Security_Features__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_ID_Legible__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Customer_Details__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_EV_Match__c, "No"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_PO_Box__c, "No"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Middle_Name__c, "No"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Citizenship_Updated__c, "No"), ISPICKVAL (Fraud_Address_Valid__c, "No")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You have selected that an error has been found in the individual's KYC and have not selected that the error has been rectified or that the customer has failed to respond with required documents. Please check the field "Have All Defects Been Rectified".
